av_event.line_text: Every year. Ours had a tin of mushy peas from about 1990 last time. Same as the shop. People clear their cupboards out and call it giving.
av_event.what: Abena laughs silently with her mouth closed, her shoulders shaking for a couple of seconds, and briefly looks down and away from the camera before looking back
